collector_side_latency_ms_note: This is requested_at->received_at (collector round-trip), NOT received_at-source_generated_at. No API in this package exposes a true provider-side generation timestamp for every response, so the execution contract's exact 'received_at-source_generated_at' metric is NOT_AVAILABLE as specified; this is the closest real, measured proxy and is reported as such rather than substituted silently.
collector_latency_near_zero_caveat: The inherited Phase 0 storage.SpikeResult dataclass stamps both requested_at and received_at via the same default_factory call at SpikeResult construction time, which happens AFTER requests.get()/post() already returned. So collector_latency_ms here measures ~0 not because the network round-trip was instant, but because this harness never captured a pre-request timestamp. This is a harness limitation inherited from Phase 0, not a real finding about API speed.
